mentions.name: Convenience Store Marathon
mentions.description: A location-based game centered on Taiwan's dense convenience store landscape: players stand at any 7-11, FamilyMart, or similar store, take a photo proving they can see the next store, walk to it, and repeat — chaining as many stores as possible into a route. The game's maps are being improved with Mapbox.
